request: Install and run https://github.com/steel-dev/steel-browser on the dyaus host for use from this BB environment, then create a new independently installable BB plugin in this repository that integrates Steel as the replacement browser infrastructure for the prior KERNEL.SH-based workflow. Keep the root orchestration-only conventions, align manifest/package/CLI/UI/docs/tests, avoid committing generated artifacts, and verify the Steel service plus the plugin's human UI and CLI surface.
message: Implemented bounded frontend RPC recovery: idempotent project/dashboard/allProjects reads get one retry after 15s; persistent stalls report actionable errors after 30s, session/policy mutations are never replayed, late responses cannot overwrite recovery, settings has retry, and empty loading error bar removed. Plugin rebuilt/reloaded. All 24 focused tests, types and build passed. Actual installed BB frontend exercised inside this project's Steel CDP browser through a local HTTP test bridge with Bandely real RPC data: desktop/mobile recover to Connected/Browsers 1 after injected first-read stalls; permanent stalls, manual retry and late failures verified. Existing sessions preserved. Remote transport cause and remote BB Connect authentication/embedded viewer content remain unverified; viewer blank in test, no claim of end-to-end remote browsing. Full repository CI and formal review pending. Evidence collection refused at iteration phase; screenshots retained in thread storage. Target main current.

lifecycle.riskRequest: Fix the Steel Browser Tools settings panel so it never sends undefined projectId values over RPC. When no BB project context is available, render a clear project-unavailable state instead of calling project RPC, while keeping Jev host configuration visible. Add focused coverage, rebuild, reload, and update the existing draft PR.

sizeDecision.reason: This is a narrow correction to the existing Steel Browser Tools surface and must ship with the same plugin capability; splitting would leave the known settings error unresolved.
